grammar_concept.title: Future Continuous: will be + verb-ing
grammar_concept.rule: Use the Future Continuous (will be + verb-ing) for an action that will be in progress at a specific point in the future.
grammar_concept.simple_explanation: Descreve algo que estará a acontecer, em curso, num momento específico do futuro — o equivalente futuro do Past Continuous.
grammar_concept.example: This time next week, I will be lying on a beach. Don't call at 9pm — I'll be having dinner.
grammar_concept.example_translation: Nesta altura na próxima semana, estarei deitado numa praia. Não ligues às 21h — estarei a jantar.
grammar_concept.common_mistake_pt: É comum confundir o Future Continuous com o futuro simples ("will" + verbo base), perdendo a ideia de que a ação estará EM CURSO nesse momento específico: dizem "I will lie on a beach" em vez de "I will be lying on a beach" quando querem dizer que estarão nesse processo, não que farão isso como facto pontual.
grammar_concept.correction: "Will be" + verbo-ing para uma ação em curso num momento específico do futuro ("At 9pm, I'll be having dinner"). Não confundir com o futuro simples ("I'll have dinner at 9pm"), que apresenta a ação como um facto ou plano, sem focar que estará a decorrer nesse instante.
grammar_concept.real_world_example: A explicar por que não pode atender: "Don't call me at 3pm, I'll be presenting to the whole team."

vocabulary.definition_en: a talk giving information about a particular subject
example_sentences: I'll be giving a presentation at 3pm.

vocabulary.definition_en: a plan of things to be done at particular times
example_sentences: According to the schedule, we'll be landing at 6pm.

vocabulary.definition_en: during the period of time between two events
example_sentences: In the meantime, I'll be preparing the documents.

exercises.prompt: Complete: This time tomorrow, I ___ (fly) to New York.
exercises.explanation: Ação em curso num momento específico do futuro → Future Continuous: will be + verbo-ing.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Usar só "will fly" (futuro simples) perde a ideia de estar em curso nesse momento exato.

correct_answer: Don't call at 9pm — I'll be having dinner.
distractors: Don't call at 9pm — I have dinner.
Don't call at 9pm — I will have dinner.
Don't call at 9pm — I am have dinner.
exercises.explanation: "I'll be having dinner" enfatiza que o jantar estará em curso às 21h.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Usar "I will have dinner" (futuro simples) soa como um plano pontual, não como algo em curso nesse momento.

correct_answer: a plan of things to be done at particular times
exercises.explanation: "Schedule" é o plano de horários de algo, como uma viagem ou o dia de trabalho.

exercises.prompt: Listen to the audio. What will the speaker be doing at 3pm tomorrow?
exercises.explanation: No áudio, ouve-se: "At 3pm tomorrow, I'll be giving a presentation to the board."
exercises.transcript: At 3pm tomorrow, I'll be giving a presentation to the board. In the meantime, could you check the schedule for the rest of the week?

exercises.prompt: Read the text: "According to the schedule, we'll be landing at 6pm. In the meantime, the crew will be serving dinner around 4pm." What will the crew be doing around 4pm?
exercises.explanation: O texto indica diretamente: "the crew will be serving dinner around 4pm".

exercises.prompt: Translate to English: "Não me ligues às 15h — estarei a apresentar ao conselho."
correct_answer: Don't call me at 3pm — I'll be presenting to the board.
exercises.explanation: "I'll be presenting" enfatiza que a apresentação estará em curso às 15h.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Usar "I will present" (futuro simples) em vez de "I'll be presenting" perde a ideia de estar em curso nesse momento.

steps.content: "Will be" often contracts and links smoothly in speech: "I will be" → "I'll be" /aɪl bi/. The verb-ing that follows usually carries the main stress: I'll be HAVing dinner, I'll be FLYing to New York.

steps.prompt: Describe what you will be doing at specific times tomorrow (this time tomorrow, at 9am, at 6pm), using the Future Continuous.
Write 5 sentences about what you and people you know will be doing at specific moments next week.
